findings.reason: Replaces app-only implication with retained shared-event/calendar/account/access records confirmed by owner and source. Explicit shared-content scope avoids claiming every private calendar is uploaded. Attachment language is conditional on user inclusion and has no Photo Library/microphone claim.
Google authorization plus device Contacts permission and device import/update are separately described from recipient processing. No address-book bulk-upload assertion.

Owner-confirmed personalization with consent and pinned SDK data types support guarded may/include wording. It does not promise all data anonymous or assert every SDK path executes. Consent/privacy-option source exists; device permission remains qualified.

Native sync transmits enabled=false after permissions/status calculation when token/session exist; backend validates and stores enabled status. Delivery configuration remains distinct from record retention. Does not promise live production delivery.

Selected place or permission-based current location, Apple WeatherKit request, displayed-area map coordinates and device cache align with prior immutable evidence. Shared-event venue storage explicitly separated; no broad no-retention/no-location claim. App scope avoids conflating website Open-Meteo demo.
AWS/SES evidence supports source-defined sharing delivery. No new confidentiality-contract guarantee, sale/no-sale assertion, or invented payment-card collection.
Signout/disconnection/subscription cancellation do not imply server/copy erasure; aligns with retained account/share/snapshot records. No invented retention interval or completed deletion deadline.

Privacy contact office@arte-soft.com, route, layout, backlink and TypeScript SEO remain unchanged. Existing security and notification-of-policy-change boilerplate remains unchanged; this review is not a security audit or legal compliance certification.
